name: Stinking Cloud
summary: 20-foot-radius gas: creatures starting a turn in it make a Con save or are Poisoned and lose their action.
text: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of nauseating yellow gas forms, centered on a point within 90 feet. The cloud is Heavily Obscured and lasts for the duration unless a strong wind (such as the one from Gust of Wind) disperses it. Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failure it has the Poisoned condition until the end of that turn, and while Poisoned this way it can't take an action or a Bonus Action.
